Livermore's capital projects

Every project in the city's Capital Improvement Program, under the fund that pays for it: what the two-year budget gives each one, and what the plan projects for the three years after.

210 printed project lines across 5 columns, 1050 figures in all, from the Budget Book's project listing by fund. Every figure is one the city printed and links to the extracted text of the page it was read from; a dash is a zero the page prints as a dash.
